subject: Pricing structure clarification and packaging options for Clearcrest
messages:
From: Sophie Mulroney <sophie.mulroney@clearcrest.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearcrest Procurement <procurement@clearcrest.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify pricing structure / packaging before exec review

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency numbers. Before we take this to our execs and procurement, we need a clear view on economics and packaging options. A few specific asks: 

- Can you confirm the blended per-token rate for a 12-month, 10M token/month profile (we have steady burst windows)?
- How do overage tiers work if we exceed committed tokens in a given month?
- Do you support seat-based bundles for a mix of hosted API + dedicated inference pools? Pricing examples would be helpful.
- Our incumbent offered a blended rate of $0.017/token if we prepay 6 months — can Redwood match or structure an equivalent concession?

Procurement will also need a rough SOW and expected onboarding duration so they can align budget cycles. Attaching our procurement questionnaire in a separate email.

Appreciate quick clarity — we have an internal review on Friday.

Best,
Sophie
VP Product, Clearcrest Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Mulroney <sophie.mulroney@clearcrest.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing structure / packaging before exec review

Hi Sophie — great to hear the demo resonated. Quick answers below and I can follow up with a short, formal one-page economics memo and an SOW stub.

Blended rate (12m / 10M token/mo):
- Option A (Hosted API, month-to-month): $0.024/token list, volume tiers reduce to $0.019/token at 8M+ sustained monthly usage. No prepay required.
- Option B (12-month commit, billed monthly): blended ~$0.0165/token if you commit to the 12-month 10M baseline and agree to standard overage tiers. This assumes no additional premium features (e.g., private deployment).
- Option C (Dedicated pool + support): base runtime fee + discounted per-token at ~$0.014/token on large prepay; requires an initial provisioning lead time (2–4 weeks).

Overage handling: We apply a soft overage cap. Overage up to 15% billed at 1.25x committed tier rate; beyond that we switch to on-demand rate unless you opt into an auto-burst credit that smooths billing (can be included in contract).

Seat/bundle mix: We can combine hosted and dedicated: seat licenses for admin/operators + hosted API for product traffic. We normally structure as a bundle with an annual commitment and a discount ladder tied to token and seat commitments. Examples: 50 seats + 10M tokens = 12% off list; 100 seats + 25M tokens = 18% off list.

Matching competitor concession: We can approximate the incumbent's $0.017/token by offering a 6-months prepaid concession with a blended effective rate near $0.016 on the committed volume, but that requires prepayment and a 12-month minimum term. If procurement needs net-new crediting (e.g., onboarding credits) we can carve those into the first invoice.

I'll draft a one-pager and attach a proposal (proposal v3) and a short SOW draft for timelines. Are there any regulatory or data residency constraints we should call out?

Thanks,
Lauren
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-proposal-v3.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: approval request — prepay concession for Clearcrest (CLR-2026-09)

Team,

Sophie from Clearcrest is asking us to match a $0.017/token blended offer from their incumbent for a 12-month, 10M token/mo profile. I proposed a structure that reaches ~ $0.0165/token if they prepay 6 months and commit to 12 months. They also want clear overage rules and a short SOW.

Key commercials I recommend: 
- 12-month minimum term, 6-month prepay to achieve the $0.0165 blended rate on committed volume.
- Onboarding credit: $25k to offset integration cost (one-time credit applied to first invoice).
- Auto-burst credit included for up to 15% monthly overage at negotiated rate.

Impact/ask: What is the estimated margin hit on a typical hosted API deal at that rate? If acceptable, can we approve a 6-month prepaid concession and route final contract to Legal with the SOW?

Notes on risks: Prepay reduces churn but ties up capacity planning. If we add dedicated pool option later, we should keep carveouts for performance SLAs.

Jordan — can you sign off on pricing authorization? Karthik — any ops/deployment concerns on the 6-week onboarding timeline?

Thanks,
Lauren

From: Sophie Mulroney <sophie.mulroney@clearcrest.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearcrest Procurement <procurement@clearcrest.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing structure / packaging before exec review

Hi Lauren — thanks, that framing helps. Procurement asked for two final confirmations before we loop in Finance: 

1) If we sign a 12-month commit and prepay 6 months, can you confirm the final blended per-token effective rate on the 10M baseline? (Please show the math & assumptions used for the blended number.)
2) Can you provide a short SOW (timeline, milestones, acceptance criteria) and confirm onboarding will not require any on-prem/hardware changes?

We attached the procurement questionnaire and our standard security addendum in a separate email. If you can return the one-page economics + SOW by end of day Monday, we can schedule a final approval call on Wednesday.

Also, a quick ask — will Redwood include a 30-day rollback window in case we encounter regression in inference latency during the initial rollout?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sophie
VP Product, Clearcrest Health

Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf (sent separately)
